assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent PNG artwork for a collectible fan passport rubber-ink stamp in ByUs. Create one beautiful, original premium rubber stamp impression, centered front view in a square image. Subject: a little open fan passport with a single four-point sparkling star emerging above it. Composition: one thick clean circular outer seal ring and one fine inner ring with four small star accents at cardinal positions; compact central illustrated emblem filling the inner area. Color palette: exclusively deep orchid-purple ink #A23AB6 with subtle natural ink opacity variation; no other hues. Medium: tactile hand-stamped ink impression, elegant slightly imperfect edges and very restrained fine speckled ink grain, readable at 64px; bold graceful rounded silhouettes, no hairline details. Flat 2D stamped impression, not a physical rubber stamp object, not 3D plastic or metal. Use a genuine transparent alpha background including transparent negative spaces within the ring. Keep 12% transparent margin on every side and the complete circular seal inside frame. No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, drop shadow, paper background, checkerboard graphic, UI or mockup. Only one stamp.
